description: The fixed query set of the development search backend evaluation (Issue #883; Owner decisions 24″, 24⁵). Every query is authored from a public fact for this evaluation; none quotes, paraphrases or derives from a manuscript. 15 Chinese queries whose best sources are Chinese sites and 15 English queries whose best sources are international sites.

rubric.hit: A query is a hit when at least one of the top five results is on a judged-correct domain: one of the query's `primary` domains or one of the reference domains of its language (`referenceDomains`) or the query's own `reference` domains. A URL is on a domain when its host is the domain or ends with `.` followed by it.
rubric.primary: Source quality: a query with `primary` domains counts a primary hit when one of the top five results is on an official or issuing-body domain it lists; listed results count the top-five results on any judged-correct domain against all results returned (at most five per query).
rubric.halves: The Chinese half is the queries with `language` zh; the international half is the queries with `international` true (here every English query). Decision 24⁵ excludes a backend that hits on neither half.

probe.query: UNESCO World Book and Copyright Day April 23
probe.note: The one fixed public query of `--probe <backend>` (slice 6b's 测试检索): reachability, latency, result count and at most three titles and URLs.
